supersedes_scope: extends docs/MARKET_MICROSTRUCTURE_DATA_AUDIT.json (V1) with the sources exercised in this phase

sources.field: aggTrades (tick prints: price, qty, isBuyerMaker, aggTradeId)
sources.availability_timestamp: derived: minute_open + 60_001 ms, bar close thereafter
sources.rate_limits: bulk download, no API rate limit
sources.pit_suitability: PIT-usable; aggregator uses only prints with timestamp < bar close
sources.sample_used: 42 daily files = 14 discontinuous days (12th and 24th of each month, 2026-03..09)

sources.use_in_phase: measured per-asset realized volatility; external volume cross-check of the aggregation (ratio 1.0 over 288 bars per asset)

sources.status_in_phase: previously tested in V1 (funding_z, NO_GROSS_EDGE); not re-run
previously tested in V1 (premium_z, NO_GROSS_EDGE); not re-run

sources.pit_suitability: PARTIAL: retention window shorter than the study period

sources.historical_depth: 8,928 points per symbol (~31 days, first timestamp 2026-08-26)
sources.measured_consequence: M-07 has NO DEV/VAL observations: no quadrant can be selected on DEV, so the pre-registered rule cannot be evaluated. Classified LIMITED_HISTORY, not a result.

sources.field: bookTicker (bid, ask, spread_bps, crossed) and depth (top-20 levels, last_update_id)
sources.event_timestamp: none (bookTicker has no exchange event time)
sources.note: synthesising a historical book from OHLCV is forbidden; M-03 (book imbalance) remains forward-collection-required

sources.probe_result: HTTP 404 with and without a 7-day window
sources.note: recorded as a measured fact, not assumed: the endpoint returned 404 in a real read-only probe

known_limitations: REST depth/bookTicker snapshots are independent polls, not a sequenced stream; there is no diff-depth reconciliation
REST aggTrades polling skipped prints in a burst on BTCUSDT (1 hole, worst_step 25): a gap-free forward capture requires the WebSocket stream
premiumIndex polling is sampled every 5 ticks, which exceeds the 15 s staleness threshold once per symbol
forward_collection.usable_as: spread measurement (per-asset, OBSERVED) and forward structure validation; NOT a fill model and NOT a historical substitute

panel_quality.dataset: aggTrades 14-day sample aggregated to 5m and intersected across BTC/ETH/SOL

data_gaps: order book history (M-03) does not exist at any provider used here: forward collection only
open interest history is ~31 days, so M-07 has no DEV/VAL window
liquidations: no accessible public endpoint from this environment (HTTP 404)
the aggTrades sample is 14 discontinuous days, not 7 continuous months
